Lina: Quick SCIM/SAML question — onboarding contractors via Okta. When we deprovision a contractor, what's the TTL before SCIM removes them from groups? We noticed a couple of apps still had access the next morning. Anyone run into this? Example mapping in our config:
```
{
  "groupMappings": [
    {"oktaGroup": "rd-contractors", "appRole": "read-only"}
  ],
  "syncInterval": "300"
}
```
Is syncInterval in seconds or minutes, and should we be worried about SAML SP session caches?

Samir: For our connector `syncInterval` is seconds. But the big split is push vs poll. If your Okta->SCIM connector is configured for push events, removals are near-instant. Poll mode respects `syncInterval` and can be delayed by that + processing windows. Also watch for `softDelete` semantics — some directories mark users as deactivated but keep them until a purge job runs.

Ria: Also note app-side SAML/SP sessions — even after SCIM removes group membership the SP session can persist if the app doesn't check group claims on each login. We had one app that kept granting access until its session TTL expired (24h).

Lina: Good point. Also a quick security check: are provisioning logs redacted? I found an older audit that had displayName/email in cleartext. We should ensure PII is masked.

Samir: Yep — make sure the `provisioning.audit` pipeline has `redact=true`. The connector emits debug attributes unless you flip the redact flag. Example CLI check: `rdctl logs get provisioning --redact` shows redaction status.

provision-bot: scim-sync v2.1 deployed to staging at 2026-03-10T14:02:00Z — includes fix for faster purge scheduling.

Lina: Action items from this thread:
1) Confirm connector mode (push vs poll) for the Okta tenant.
2) Temporarily set syncInterval=60 in staging and monitor.
3) Verify app session TTLs for critical apps + document which ones need immediate session invalidation on deprovision.
4) Run a log audit to confirm `provisioning.audit` has `redact=true` and purge older logs with PII.
I'll open a small PR to change the staging sync interval and add a checklist to the runbook.

Samir: Ping @Lina when PR is up, I'll do the review. :thumbsup:

Ria: I can take the log audit after the PR merges, happy to help.

Lina: Thanks all — filing the PR now.
